digest.component_or_area: test fixtures / git-backed repository topology builders
propositions: Five function-scoped fixture builders repeatedly construct identical virgin git/rebar topologies from scratch for every test consumer, contributing 103.416 worker-seconds across the top five affected test modules in Verify run 31846417650.

Runtime measurement probes confirm that isolated copies of pre-built fixture templates execute 12x-23x faster than real initialization, with equivalent invariant state after setup and disjoint per-test artifacts (refs, worktree paths, identities).

Session-scoped templates with per-test isolated copies, deep-copy rollback, and lazy per-environment identity reminting are standard practice in Django, Rails, GitLab, and pytest, with prior acceptance in tickets peculiar-calmy-bubblefish and adored-duskish-kissingbug.

The clone_topology_template helper must remint asymmetric op-cert signing keys (.opcert-key/.pub) in addition to environment identity and .signing-key to prevent clones from sharing private signing authority.

All 125 affected tests pass with identical assertions and coverage after migrating only proven-equivalent fixtures; direct initialization/recovery contracts continue to build from scratch and remain unweakened.
